mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise and GDP growth exceeds 2%, it signals a strong demand for housing and increased economic activity, leading to higher stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where housing starts and GDP growth are both high.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4% and the CPI is above 2%, it signals a tightening monetary policy and high inflation, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which drives down stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where interest rates and inflation are both high.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5% and payroll employment growth exceeds 1%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales rise and GDP growth exceeds 2%, it signals a strong demand for goods and services, leading to higher stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where retail sales and GDP growth are both high during periods of monetary easing.
